title: Bad Dates Season 2 with Joel Kim Booster!

sentences.en: Hey, SmartList listeners, it's Sean Hayes with some exciting news.
sentences.zh: 嘿，SmartList 的听众们，我是肖恩·海耶斯，带来一个激动人心的消息。

sentences.en: One of our SmartList media shows is back with a brand new hoSt.
sentences.zh: 我们 SmartList 媒体旗下的一个节目带着全新的主持人回归了。

sentences.en: I'm talking about the one and only Bad Dates.
sentences.zh: 我说的就是独一无二的《糟糕约会》（Bad Dates）。

sentences.en: And for season two, it's hosted by the hilarious Joel Kim Booster.
sentences.zh: 第二季将由搞笑天才乔尔·金·布斯特主持。

sentences.en: You might know Joel from Apple TV's Loot, Hulu's Fire Island, his Netflix comedy special,
sentences.zh: 你可能在 Apple TV 的《钱钱钱钱》、Hulu 的《火烧岛》、他的 Netflix 喜剧特辑中见过乔尔，

sentences.en: or his very revealing guest role on HBO's Industry.
sentences.zh: 或者他在 HBO 的《投行风云》中那个非常大胆的客串角色。

sentences.en: This season, he'll be your guide through all of the iconic and painfully true Bad Date stories
sentences.zh: 这一季，他将带你领略那些标志性且令人痛苦的真实约会故事，

sentences.en: that his guests reveal with all the gory details you loved in season one.
sentences.zh: 嘉宾们会像第一季那样，毫无保留地分享你所喜爱的那些血淋淋的细节。

sentences.en: And we'll still hear real letters and voice messages from listeners sharing their own worst dates.
sentences.zh: 我们依然会听到听众发来的真实信件和语音留言，分享他们自己最糟糕的约会经历。

sentences.en: Plus, Joel will weigh in about his own lengthy and bizarre time in the dating trenches.
sentences.zh: 此外，乔尔还会分享他自己在约会战壕中那段漫长而离奇的时光。

sentences.en: We love the show because everybody has had them.
sentences.zh: 我们喜欢这个节目，因为每个人都经历过这些。

sentences.en: Everybody can relate to them.
And now it's time to laugh at them on season two of Bad Dates with your new host, Joel Kim Booster.
sentences.zh: 现在，是时候在由新主持人乔尔·金·布斯特主持的《糟糕约会》第二季中，一起嘲笑这些经历了。

sentences.en: Check out this clip from the show and follow Bad Dates wherever you get your podcasts.
sentences.zh: 来看看这个节目片段，并在你获取播客的任何平台关注《糟糕约会》吧。
